messages.author: FyD
messages.body:
Dear All,
I ran a script to check gaff2:
It looks like there are duplicate/different values for several
dihedral angles/improper angles.
(see below; 'frcmod.user' is 'gaff211.dat' from AmberTools24).
Did I miss something?
Best Francois
